text: Adjusting the commercial benefits attached to a token operates as a quasi fiscal policy tool: increasing those benefits raises aggregate demand for a given token supply and can offset the depreciating effect of a large supply in circulation.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615

isBasedOn.name: Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags

abstract: First, the increase in commercial benefits associated with a token heightens the aggregate demand of the given token supply. Second, commercial benefits associated with a token issuance can help offset depreciated supply scarcity

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: tokens carrying discounts or other usage-linked commercial benefits
